Lane 1 — Ads: lip-synced testimonials + 15s one-take brand films.
Lane 2 — AI Drama: locked characters + real performances + episode output.
Lane 3 — Interactive: physics-accurate + consistent art + broadcast audio.

formatting: Medium essay post + 40s video. Prescriptive.

hook: "Koriderm is absolutely CRUSHING with these DRAMA ads rn."
body: A 6-step Koriderm-style drama tutorial: (1) build the drama around the problem, never the product in the first 3 seconds — e.g., a girl spills coffee on her wedding dress minutes before the ceremony; (2) script it with an LLM (shocking start, 2-3 characters, rising tension, product as resolution, 5-8s scenes); (3) lock character reference images; (4) generate scenes in Seedance/Kling/Veo; (5) reveal the product with a real product image, honest results; (6) assemble in CapCut with captions/music/SFX, 9:16, test openings. "Instead of begging people to watch your ads, you're making something they actually want to finish."

Step 2: LLM script — shocking start, 2-3 characters, tension, product as resolution, 5-8s scenes.
Step 3: lock character reference images (face/hair/clothes consistent).
Step 4: generate 5-8s scenes in Seedance/Kling/Veo.
Step 5: reveal with a REAL product image; honest results.
Step 6: CapCut assembly — captions, music, SFX; 9:16; test openings.
Payoff line: make something they want to finish.
formatting: Long numbered tutorial + 60s video + photo. Step-by-step with a copy-paste prompt.
why_it_works: A numbered pipeline with a copy-paste prompt turns an intimidating format into an afternoon project.
what_to_steal: The entire 6-step pipeline as LC's drama SOP — especially step 1 (problem-first, e.g., necklace turns neck green before the wedding) and step 5 (real product image for the reveal, honest results).
